first_page: Chess page /chess/ for players who want to play and learn without an account. First: board vs Verse with a clock, move list, PGN/FEN in and out, a daily puzzle from the open Lichess puzzle set, an analysis mode with eval bar from the existing search, and a link that carries a game so a friend can play by correspondence. Will not build: live pairing servers, ratings ladders, tournaments or forums.
